prompt_instructions: Attach approved product, logo, layout, and licensed person references for faithful reconstruction.
Do not claim unsupported specifications; use the visible copy only after product/legal approval.
Use external typesetting for exact brand typography and readable feature text.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end e-commerce infographic featuring Apple AirPods (latest generation). A young woman (same face and identity as the provided reference image) is the central subject, shown in a clean studio setting with soft, diffused lighting. She is wearing AirPods in her ears, naturally integrated into the scene, and holding the open AirPods charging case in her hand at chest level, slightly angled toward the camera. The composition should feel premium and minimal, with a crisp white or light gradient background. Include subtle reflections and soft shadows for a polished product-ad look. The AirPods case should be glossy white with visible earbuds inside and a small LED indicator light. Add modern infographic elements around the subject: – Thin, elegant pointer lines highlighting key features – Minimal icons and short labels such as “Active Noise Cancellation,” “Spatial Audio,” “Long Battery Life,” and “Seamless Connectivity” – Clean sans-serif typography (Apple-style aesthetic) – Balanced layout with negative space, not cluttered. Style: ultra-realistic, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, commercial photography quality, Apple-inspired design language. Color palette: white, light grey, soft blue accents. Aspect ratio: 1:1. Resolution: 4K, highly detailed, professional product showcase
prompt.negative_prompt: unlicensed likeness, wrong product geometry, cluttered layout, harsh shadows, off-brand typography, unreadable labels, low resolution, watermark, signature
